correctness.rationale: A missing link cuts the dependency cycle into feed-forward paths. Starting at each cut, the limiting logistic carrying capacity gives x_i*=max(0,1−σ e_i x_(i+1)*). Once the input has converged, comparison by constant-capacity logistic equations proves convergence from positive data. In weak inhibition the capacities are positive; in strong inhibition the recursion alternates 0 and 1 along each path, and all capacities are nonzero. At equilibrium the triangular Jacobian requires selection of exactly this recursion for a Hurwitz state: the diagonal is −x_i* on occupied sites and the invasion rate on vacant sites. On the intact cycle the positive equilibrium is uniquely uniform since I+σP is invertible off σ=1. Its eigenvalues are −(1+σ exp(2πik/n))/(1+σ); the least cosine is −1 on even n and −cos(π/n) on odd n. For a Hurwitz boundary state a vacancy must have negative invasion rate; this is impossible for σ<1. For σ>1 two vacancies cannot be adjacent. A vacancy forces its predecessor to be one, which forces the next predecessor to be vacant; this propagates around the cycle and yields just the even alternations. Their full Jacobian is block triangular with strictly negative diagonals. Thus the sole exceptional graph event is intactness, with probability q^n. At a fixed vertex, j consecutive retained edges followed by a cut has probability (1−q)q^j, and it gives a survivor exactly when j is even. Summing j<n proves the expectation with K=0 on intact graphs, including q=0,1. The exponential rare-deletion limit uses fixed σ>1 and the odd threshold tending to 1. The reported finite support enumeration was inspected, not executed; no claim about non-equilibrium attractors or the excluded critical gains follows.

evidence: Nassor et al. define ensemble measures and use Bernoulli connectance times random strengths for a sampled sparse ensemble, enumerating supports numerically.
Hong–Pego constrain support exclusion and multiplicity, including that two stable communities cannot differ by exactly one species; those results do not enumerate supports of the one-sided cycle.

evidence: The secant criterion accounts for when the intact odd interior state loses stability. It says nothing about boundary invasion or what happens when the directed cycle is cut. The discrete logistic analogue has no edge-deletion probability law.
claim_vs_prior_implication.reasoning: The atom q^n is the elementary probability of an intact graph, not novel on its own. Its relevance to S, and the mean survivor count, require the broken-path recursion and the exhaustive even/odd boundary-state analysis, not a mechanical substitution into the known secant threshold or ensemble framework.

originality.rationale: Prior work includes random-system stable-community statistics, general stable-support constraints and the negative-feedback secant threshold. The stated distinct result is the exhaustive Hurwitz census in this independently thinned directed cycle, combined with its finite-size multiplicity law and mean richness on broken graphs. The secant threshold alone is not new.
residual_risks: An unlocated specialized directed-cycle ecology or general equilibrium enumeration theorem may give more of the deterministic census. The direct Sontag secant source was not recovered; no originality is ascribed to that ingredient.
The indexed comparisons are bounded and do not certify historical priority.

value.rationale: This is an analytically tractable benchmark for a motivated ensemble quantity: the number of stable communities under uncertain network structure. A single cut erases the exceptional parity-dependent stable-state counts, a structural conclusion that supports the exact finite-size probability and rare-deletion limits. Full transverse stability and the incomplete-graph survivor mean add quantitative information not available from an interior secant test alone.
